competing_explanation: The policy may define the 30-day window from purchase or order date, or impose conditions that limit full refunds for standard items.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items, measured from delivery.
predicted_outcome: H_P is supported: standard items can be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery.
refutation_criterion: Authoritative current policy text shows the full-refund window for standard items is not 30 days from delivery, such as 30 days from purchase, a different number of days, or no full refund.
